assumptions.statement: The submitted site and key-area polygons are the repository's provisional rough geometry, not official planning boundaries.
assumptions.impact: All derived areas, ratios, figures and spatial placements are low-confidence concept references.
assumptions.trigger: Organizer publishes rights-cleared official SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons.
assumptions.required_action: Replace constraints and regenerate all design layers, metrics, figures, HTML and PDFs in EPSG:4548.

assumptions.statement: Background OSM review indicates that the provisional overall polygon and Dazhongsi key-area geometry may not align with the named heritage park and Dazhongsi station.
assumptions.impact: Named-place callouts are diagrammatic and cannot establish parcel inclusion.
assumptions.trigger: Official polygon and surveyed base map become available.
assumptions.required_action: Run positional QA and move or remove any unsupported callout.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, ownership, cadastral parcels, road redlines, building surveys, parking supply, municipal capacity and engineering constraints are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No statutory FAR, height, demolition, road widening, utility or investment conclusion is made.
assumptions.trigger: Competent authorities and owners provide current official files.
assumptions.required_action: Professional teams verify parcel-by-parcel feasibility and recalculate capacity.

assumptions.statement: The published text for Qinghuayuan Station's protection scope and construction-control zones is authoritative, but the official control-line drawing has not been digitised into this package.
assumptions.impact: The City Question Station stays inside the heritage building only as low-intervention interpretation; new devices are proposed outside as reversible prototypes subject to review.
assumptions.trigger: Official control-line drawing, measured survey and conservation review are obtained.
assumptions.required_action: Complete heritage impact assessment and approve every fixing, service route, foundation and event operation.

assumptions.statement: No current pedestrian, cycling, public-transport, parking, origin-destination or visitor-segmentation survey is available.
assumptions.impact: User personas describe plausible weekday/weekend patterns but are not population shares or demand forecasts.
assumptions.trigger: Four-season weekday/weekend counts and intercept surveys are completed.
assumptions.required_action: Recalibrate programme, opening hours, crowd thresholds and mobility interventions.

assumptions.statement: Hydrology, drainage, flood risk, soil, tree inventory, biodiversity and heat-island data are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Blue-green measures are conceptual reversible pilots, not hydraulic or ecological engineering conclusions.
assumptions.trigger: Qualified surveys and authority requirements become available.
assumptions.required_action: Complete sponge-city, arboricultural, ecological and utility coordination design.

assumptions.statement: Named operating bodies in scenario cards are proposed role types, not confirmed appointments or commitments.
assumptions.impact: Budgets, staffing, procurement and liability remain to be negotiated.
assumptions.trigger: A lead entity accepts a pilot charter and budget.
assumptions.required_action: Sign data, safety, maintenance, accessibility, complaint and exit protocols before launch.

assumptions.statement: The seven international cases are mechanism references under different laws, land systems, markets and institutional arrangements.
assumptions.impact: No foreign metric, policy or certification is treated as locally applicable.
assumptions.trigger: A local pilot owner proposes a specific mechanism.
assumptions.required_action: Complete Chinese legal, planning, procurement and operational review.

assumptions.statement: Source records are valid only for their stated publisher, date, scope and permitted use; this package has not established a live source-monitoring service.
assumptions.impact: A withdrawn, superseded or scope-changed source can no longer support dependent claims, metrics, figures or pilot expansion.
assumptions.trigger: Before every new evidence gate and at each annual public statement during operation.
assumptions.required_action: Recheck priority sources, record the result and downgrade every dependent artifact when validity cannot be confirmed.
